solution.paragraph: Let $$u = 1 + \sin x$$ so that $$du = \cos xdx$$ . Then
$$\begin{array}{l} {{\int{\frac{\cos x}{1 + \sin x}dx}} = {\int{\frac{du}{u} = \ln|u| + C}}} \\ {\phantom{\int{\frac{\cos x}{1 + \sin x}dx}} = {\ln\left| {1 + \sin x} \right| + C}} \end{array}$$
